title: Real AWS ALB traffic cutover, live verification, rollback and reconciliation
implemented: CutoverRequest extended with typed aws routing identity (loadBalancerArn, listenerArn, ruleArn, candidateTargetGroupArn, previousTargetGroupArn, targetId, targetPort)
AwsCliRunner interface + SpawnAwsCliRunner - enables deterministic command construction verification
AWSTrafficRouter.cutover() - real modify-listener or modify-rule to change forward action from OLD TG to NEW TG, then re-reads AWS to confirm
AWSTrafficRouter.revert() - real modify-listener or modify-rule to restore exact previous TG, then re-reads AWS to confirm
AWSTrafficRouter.resolveTarget() - uses discoverRouting (active forward target), not 'any healthy target'
AWSTrafficRouter.reconcile() - compares forward configuration (not target IDs)
AWSTrafficRouter.capabilities() - separates adapter support from runtime readiness
TrafficRouterFactory - preserves AWS-selected-but-BLOCKED with real reason; returns NoopTrafficRouter only when no AWS config exists
DeploymentActivationService - populates the aws field on CutoverRequest for both activate() and rollback()
removed: Unsafe cast (req as unknown as { targetId?: string }).targetId at aws-traffic-router.ts:159
register-targets as a substitute for ALB routing cutover
resolveTarget that returned the first healthy target without checking active routing
reconcile that compared target IDs instead of forward configuration
